facts.fact: NBCUniversal and Tubi were announced as the first publishers to offer Storefronts, which let publishers in the Universal Ads ecosystem merchandise their own premium content on the self-service platform with a branded landing page.
facts.quote: NBCUniversal and Tubi are the first publishers to offer this unique offering.

facts.fact: Universal Ads says advertisers can buy audiences across its inventory from more than 15 top publishers.
facts.quote: complementing the ability to buy audiences across Universal Ads' inventory from more than 15 top publishers.

facts.fact: Universal Ads says six new publishers recently joined its platform, giving brands access to content from over 15 premium publishers.
facts.quote: with six new publishers recently joining the platform to give brands access to content from over 15 premium publishers.

facts.fact: Universal Ads says Storefronts were in alpha at the time of the post, with wide availability planned for later in 2025.
facts.quote: Currently in alpha, Universal Ads is already seeing an incredible response from advertisers as we get closer to making it widely available later this year

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that Storefronts let advertisers of all sizes buy directly from one premium publisher, without the big budget previously needed for direct publisher access.
facts.quote: there hasn’t been a simple path for brands to directly access these publishers without a big budget.

facts.fact: The Universal Ads site footer states the copyright is held by Comcast Advertising, with the notice dated 2026.
